You are an expert Roblox game developer and game designer.

Create a complete, professional Roblox game called "MonsterVerse."

GAME GENRE
- Open-world monster collecting adventure
- Exploration RPG
- Mobile and PC optimized
- Bright, colorful low-poly Roblox style
- Smooth performance (60 FPS target)
- Beginner-friendly progression
- Highly expandable for future updates

==================================================
CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP
==================================================

Spawn
↓

Explore the world

↓

Find wild monsters

↓

Catch monsters

↓

Gain coins and XP

↓

Upgrade equipment

↓

Unlock new areas

↓

Discover rarer monsters

↓

Complete monster collection

↓

Become the strongest trainer

==================================================
WORLD 1
==================================================

Create a beautiful forest world approximately 250x250 studs.

Include:

• Spawn Village
• Shop
• Quest NPC
• Monster Research Lab
• Slime Meadow
• Dense Forest
• Flower Field
• River
• Pond
• Waterfall
• Wooden Bridge
• Cave Entrance
• Ancient Tree
• Small Hills
• Dirt Paths
• Cliffs around map edges

The map should feel alive and encourage exploration.

==================================================
ART STYLE
==================================================

Low-poly

Cartoon

Bright colors

Stylized

Rounded edges

Premium Roblox quality

Soft lighting

Future Lighting

Atmosphere

Bloom

Sun Rays

Color Correction

Animated grass

Wind effects

Particle effects

==================================================
MONSTERS
==================================================

Create reusable monster framework.

Starter monsters:

Green Slime
Blue Slime
Bee
Bunny
Fox

Each monster includes:

Unique model

Idle animation

Walk animation

Run animation

Spawn animation

Catch animation

Respawn animation

Unique sounds

Unique stats

==================================================
AI
==================================================

Every monster should:

Idle

Look around

Random wandering

Avoid obstacles

Stay inside spawn radius

Use PathfindingService

Detect players

Watch nearby players

Run away when threatened

Return to wandering

Respawn after being caught

All AI should use reusable state machines.

==================================================
MONSTER DATA
==================================================

Each monster stores:

Name

Description

Health

Speed

Run Speed

Level

XP Reward

Coin Reward

Catch Chance

Respawn Time

Rarity

Biome

Favorite Weather

Favorite Time

==================================================
RARITIES
==================================================

Common

Uncommon

Rare

Epic

Legendary

Mythic

Secret

Divine

Celestial

==================================================
PLAYER
==================================================

Player has:

Coins

Gems

XP

Level

Inventory

Monster Collection

Quest Progress

Achievements

Settings

Statistics

==================================================
CATCHING SYSTEM
==================================================

Player approaches monster

Press E

Play catch animation

Play sound

Particle effects

Monster disappears

Monster added to inventory

Coins and XP awarded

Monster respawns after timer

==================================================
INVENTORY
==================================================

Grid inventory

Monster cards

Search bar

Sorting

Filters

Equip

Favorite

Delete

View stats

==================================================
SHOP
==================================================

Sell monsters

Capture capsules

Backpack upgrades

Speed upgrades

Cosmetics

Gamepasses

Bundles

Daily deals

==================================================
QUESTS
==================================================

Daily

Weekly

Story

Side quests

Rewards

Progress bars

Quest tracking

==================================================
ACHIEVEMENTS
==================================================

Catch monsters

Earn coins

Reach levels

Unlock worlds

Find secrets

Complete collection

==================================================
SAVE SYSTEM
==================================================

Use DataStoreService.

Save:

Coins

XP

Level

Inventory

Monster collection

Achievements

Quest progress

Settings

==================================================
USER INTERFACE
==================================================

Top:

Coins

Gems

XP Bar

Level

Bottom:

Inventory

Monsters

Shop

Quests

Map

Settings

Buttons should have:

Hover animation

Click animation

Sound effects

Rounded design

Glassmorphism

Mobile responsive

==================================================
AUDIO
==================================================

Forest ambience

Birds

Wind

River

Waterfall

Monster sounds

Button clicks

Coins

Quest complete

Level up

==================================================
PERFORMANCE
==================================================

StreamingEnabled

LOD friendly

Optimized scripts

Object pooling

Efficient AI

Low memory usage

Mobile optimized

==================================================
CODE QUALITY
==================================================

Use ModuleScripts.

Separate client and server logic.

Use RemoteEvents and RemoteFunctions securely.

Write clean, well-commented, modular Lua code.

Organize folders professionally.

Avoid duplicated code.

==================================================
FUTURE EXPANSION
==================================================

Design every system to support:

100+ monsters

20+ worlds

Trading

Evolution

Bosses

Guilds

Raids

PvP

Seasonal events

Weather system

Day/night cycle

Crafting

Mounts

Pets

==================================================
FINAL GOAL
==================================================

Build a polished, expandable Roblox game that feels like a premium monster-collecting adventure with smooth gameplay, professional UI, reusable systems, optimized performance, and a strong foundation for long-term updates.

answers.ask: Are the Shop, Monster Research Lab and Cave actually entered, or interacted with from outside? Interiors change the build route.
answers.answer: Use simple enterable interiors for the Shop and Monster Research Lab, and make the Cave a short accessible cave area entered through its entrance.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] building-interior — Q: Are the Shop, Monster Research Lab and Cave actually entered, or interacted with from outside? Interiors change the build route. A: Use simple enterable interiors for the Shop and Monster Research Lab, and make the Cave a short accessible cave area entered through its entrance.

## Enriched image prompt
Build a bright, colourful low-poly forest world approximately 250 by 250 studs. Centre a safe Spawn Village containing a clustered shop, Quest NPC, and Monster Research Lab, with simple enterable interiors for the shop and lab. Dirt paths branch from the village to a Slime Meadow, Dense Forest, Flower Field, and a short accessible cave entered through a visible cave mouth. A river crosses the map into a pond and waterfall, with a wooden bridge carrying a main path over it. Add an ancient tree as the major landmark, small rounded hills, animated grass, and cliffs around the map edges. Provide habitat ground for Green Slime, Blue Slime, Bee, Bunny, and Fox populations. Keep the style premium but efficient: rounded low-poly forms, bright colours, soft lighting, wind, and restrained atmospheric particles.

## Genre
The dominant genre is RPG because levels, XP, equipment upgrades, quests, and area unlocks drive progression. Adventure is secondary because exploration and discovery structure the world.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-open`, spelled Single Contiguous Map for RPG: village, habitats, paths, water, and cave entrance share one 250-by-250-stud world. The closest preset is Turn-based RPG, which fits a monster-collecting town-and-overworld layout regardless of combat resolution.

## Config requirements
Use `safezone-town` for Spawn Village and `social-hub` for its shop, Quest NPC, and lab cluster. Use `building-interior` for the shop, lab, and short cave; `path-trail` for dirt paths; `water-body` for river, pond, and waterfall; `terrain-relief` for hills, cliffs, waterfall drop, and cave overhang; `landmark-focal` for the ancient tree; and `gate-progression` for visible future-area boundaries. Use `npc-population` in both streams for the Quest NPC and the five named wild-monster species with their habitat ground.

## Layout requirements
Place `npc-population` zones for Green Slime and Blue Slime around meadow and water ground, Bees in the Flower Field, Bunnies near meadow or forest edge, Foxes in Dense Forest, and the Quest NPC in Spawn Village. Add a free-text SpawnZone in the village. No hostile `spawner-npc` is used because these wild monsters flee rather than attack.

## Layout components
The top-level world contains Spawn Village, Slime Meadow, Dense Forest, Flower Field, river, pond, waterfall, wooden bridge, short cave, ancient tree, small hills, paths, and cliff boundary. Subordinate interior zones are the Shop, Monster Research Lab, and Cave, all linked physically to the exterior rather than split into separate maps.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: the compact zone relationships, path connectivity, bridge crossing, habitats, and linked interiors should be fixed before decorative dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use medium scale, fixed by the 250-by-250-stud world and the need to read individual buildings and habitats. The theme is bright rounded low-poly fantasy forest. `P3` covers exterior-to-interior transitions, `P2` covers the cave overhang, `tiered` captures hills and cliffs, and `CHECK` applies to the river, pond, and waterfall.
